content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for ITBP Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for ITBP Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the required medical qualifications and eligibility conditions prescribed for each post. Super Specialist Medical Officer: Candidates having required super speciality medical qualifications as per ITBP rules. Specialist Medical Officer: Candidates having MBBS degree along with relevant Post Graduate Medical qualification. Medical Officer: Candidates having MBBS degree from a recognized university and valid medical registration.
